markers: | description = The shield shrouds the wearer with {{Cond|Force Conduit}} at the start of its turn in combat.

sources.title: Shield Bash
markers: | description = When a foe hits you with a melee attack, you can use your reaction to knock it {{Cond|Prone}} unless they succeed a {{Saving Throw|Dexterity}}.

summary: +2 AC shield grants Force Conduit and Shield Bash.

fields.Shield Conduit: Gain 2 turns of Force Conduit at the start of your turn in combat. Up to 7 turns. Each remaining turn reduces incoming Bludgeoning, Piercing and Slashing by 1.
fields.Force burst: With at least 5 turns remaining, a melee hit dealing damage after reductions spends all stacks for 1d4 Force within 20 ft. Redirected Warding Bond damage can be reduced but cannot trigger the burst.
fields.Shield Bash: When hit by a melee attack, spend a Reaction. The attacker makes a Strength save against your spell save DC or falls Prone for 1 turn. The tooltip instead names Dexterity.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and exact item and dependency citations. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
